statusNote: Nigel Farage resigned as MP on 7 July 2026 and the Commons accepted his resignation on 8 July. Reform UK has said it will move the writ for the by-election to be held on Thursday 6 August 2026. The full nomination and postal-vote timetable is confirmed once the writ is moved.

keyDates.label: Writ moved in the Commons
keyDates.note: Reform UK has said it will move the writ for a poll on 6 August; this sets the formal timetable

keyDates.label: Deadline to register to vote
keyDates.note: usually 12 working days before polling day — expected in mid-to-late July

keyDates.label: Deadline for new postal vote applications
keyDates.note: usually 11 working days before polling day — expected in mid-to-late July

keyDates.label: Statement of Persons Nominated published
keyDates.note: the official candidate list, published after nominations close

keyDates.label: Polling day
keyDates.note: polls open 7am–10pm; the date announced by Reform UK, formally fixed when the writ is moved
